# pbs_acme_directories (Data Source)

Lists the ACME directories a Proxmox Backup Server knows by name, as its web interface offers them for a new account: Let's Encrypt's production and staging directories. `directory` of `pbs_acme_account` takes any other directory's URL as well. The list is built into PBS; any user may read it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pbs_acme_directories" "known" {}

data "pbs_acme_tos" "staging" {
  directory = data.pbs_acme_directories.known.directories[1].url
}

# Register at Let's Encrypt's staging directory, the second PBS knows, to try
# things out. Use a real address in contact: Let's Encrypt refuses the example
# domains.
resource "pbs_acme_account" "staging" {
  name      = "staging"
  contact   = "pbs-admins@example.net"
  directory = data.pbs_acme_directories.known.directories[1].url
  tos_url   = data.pbs_acme_tos.staging.url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `directories` (Attributes List) The directories, in PBS's order: the first is the one an account uses when it names none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--directories))

<a id="nestedatt--directories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `directories`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name of the directory, such as `Let's Encrypt V2`.
- `url` (String) URL of the directory, such as `https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory`.
